statement: Right panel of canvas 1006194 (67r): concentric circular diagram. Centre: an eight-rayed star with long narrow dotted ochre rays laid over a scalloped rosette on a blue-green square wash; one ray on the left trails a dotted line outward. Around the inner disc: 12 small round faces, each beside a crescent, 6 crescents red and 6 yellow (clockwise from about 12 o'clock: red, yellow, red, yellow, yellow, red, red, yellow, red, yellow, red, yellow). Outside: a ring of 12 radial sectors holding text, then a band of hatch-stroke groups with some ochre-washed segments, with 12 red labels written around it. The transcription's label blocks match these counts (f67r2.1-12: 12 lines; 52-63: 12 lines; 64-71: 8 lines around the star), so each object carries its block as label_group. Which line goes with which face cannot be fixed from line ids without reading the words, so labels are null.
